basic_profile.bio: I'm Alex, a recent college graduate navigating the complexities of post-college life. Originally from Philadelphia, I recently moved back home to Pennsylvania after a brief stint in the tech industry. I'm passionate about coding, especially using Sublime Text, and I enjoy discussing societal issues and technology's role in our lives. My online activity peaks during late evenings, as I balance job searching with learning new programming languages. I'm currently single and focused on personal growth and career development.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and am self-taught in various programming tools like Sublime Text. My expertise lies in software development and user interfaces, gained through internships and numerous online courses.
